mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the philosophical and scientific study of meaning."
Semantics is the philosophical and scientific study of meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a play heightened by suspense and romantic sentiments."
Melodrama is a play heightened by suspense and romantic sentiments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest unit of grammar while the morpheme is the lowest."
The sentence is the highest unit of grammar while the morpheme is the lowest.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to create emphasis, compound sentences are deployed for balancing of ideas, while complex sentences express dependency relationships e.g. cause and effect."
Simple sentences are used to create emphasis, compound sentences are deployed for balancing of ideas, while complex sentences express dependency relationships e.g. cause and effect.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to hold the text together: "and," "but are used to balance ideas while "if," "when" indicate dependency relationship."
The conjunctions are used to hold the text together: "and," "but are used to balance ideas while "if," "when" indicate dependency relationship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the important elements of prose fiction - it defines the angle from which a particular story is narrated."
Remember that point of view is one of the important elements of prose fiction - it defines the angle from which a particular story is narrated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of literature that tells a story through the words and actions of the characters."
Drama is a form of literature that tells a story through the words and actions of the characters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a narrative device which literally means the position at which one looks at anything."
Point of view is a narrative device which literally means the position at which one looks at anything.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest unit while the sentence is the highest or the largest."
The morpheme is the smallest unit while the sentence is the highest or the largest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prose depicting a state of anarchy during a political transition."
Analysis The passage is a prose depicting a state of anarchy during a political transition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the repetition of the same consonant at the beginning of words that are close together."
Alliteration is the repetition of the same consonant at the beginning of words that are close together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of twelve pure vowels and eight diphthongs."
The twenty vowels are made up of twelve pure vowels and eight diphthongs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the three divisions of literature and it is regarded as the most accessible of all the three genres."
Prose fiction is one of the three divisions of literature and it is regarded as the most accessible of all the three genres.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the plays with puns."
Romeo and Juliet is one of the plays with puns.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a use of language in which an image represents something visual, but also often a vast number of other ideas which the poet associates with the word."
Symbolism is a use of language in which an image represents something visual, but also often a vast number of other ideas which the poet associates with the word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the serious epic."
Mock-epic is derived from the serious epic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relatively short, non-narrative poem in which a single speaker unfolds a state of mind or an emotional state."
Lyric poem A lyric poem is a relatively short, non-narrative poem in which a single speaker unfolds a state of mind or an emotional state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the arrangement of words based on their meanings."
Graphology means the arrangement of words based on their meanings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular concept in stylistics, especially in the analysis of the language of poetry."
Foregrounding is a popular concept in stylistics, especially in the analysis of the language of poetry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to all works of imagination not patterned in the verse form."
Prose may refer to all works of imagination not patterned in the verse form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very vital instrument of stylistics since it deals with the variations and the options that are available to an author."
Choice is a very vital instrument of stylistics since it deals with the variations and the options that are available to an author.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any written story of a considerable length which consists of paragraphs and chapters."
Definition of Prose Fiction A prose work is any written story of a considerable length which consists of paragraphs and chapters.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dramatic presentation that not only ends on a light-hearted note with no serious misfortune such as hurt and death to the major characters, but is also designed to create and involve humour."

A comic play is a dramatic presentation that not only ends on a light-hearted note with no serious misfortune such as hurt and death to the major characters, but is also designed to create and involve humour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expression of double meaning, and a statement in which the words suggest the opposite of their literal sense."
Irony is an expression of double meaning, and a statement in which the words suggest the opposite of their literal sense.

mode of discourse

theme
